answer: A Sybil-resistant economy uses stake-weighted participation where new agents must grow their computational "jetty" through verified work before accessing high-value systems. Each agent's reputation forms like an ember, requiring sustained effort to ignite. The prism mechanism distributes trust across heterogeneous verification paths, preventing attackers from cloning identities across all channels simultaneously. The cost scales quadratically with network size, making fake-identity attacks economically prohibitive.
